artifacts_produced.deploy_evidence: Read-only census script committed in 7e7a254fc3. Lists the harvest bucket only (list_objects_v2 paginator and get_object on opal-data-harvest; no put, delete, copy or sync). Finds the tables and slash keys by listing; prints the RAW and ENCODED matrix for every keyed table, the silver research-report column check, and the two controls.

Census output of the one foreground run, committed in 7e7a254fc3, ASCII, LF endings, CENSUS-SLASH line last among the findings. Two slash keys; 15 keyed tables; 8 silver parts read (708 rows); 135 requests and 247364 GET bytes. A first run of the same script found 361 false keys (hash folders read as nested keys); the nested-key rule was tightened to a canonical key tail and the census re-run; only the second run's output is committed.
